note: Wikisource prints a space inside the compound तपःस्वाध्यायनिरतम् (तपः स्वाध्यायनिरतं). Corrected in lines_corrected (approved by Aditya, 2026-11-11).
श्रीमाञ्छ्त्रुनिबर्हणः: a stray virāma after छ; the verse has 31 syllables. Corrected in lines_corrected (approved by Aditya, 2026-11-11).
…तत्त्वज्ञो स्मृतिमान्: a final ओ before स् is not possible sandhi. Corrected to …तत्त्वज्ञः स्मृतिमान् in lines_corrected (approved by Aditya, 2026-11-11).
सर्व गुणोपेतः: a space inside the compound सर्वगुणोपेतः.

शृङ्गवीरपुरे: the usual name is शृङ्गवेरपुर / शृङ्गिबेरपुर (so elsewhere in this text). Corrected to शृङ्गवेरपुरे in lines_corrected (approved by Aditya, 2026-11-11); the alternative शृङ्गिबेरपुरे is noted.
परम प्रीतः: a space inside the compound परमप्रीतः.
दण्डकारण्यवासीनाम्: long ī breaks the cadence of the pāda. Corrected in lines_corrected (approved by Aditya, 2026-11-11).
सोऽभ्य गच्छन्: a space inside the verb form सोऽभ्यगच्छन्.
प्रेक्ष्य चास्ति महाबलः: a slip for चास्थि (the bones of Dundubhi, the object of प्रेक्ष्य). Corrected to चास्थि in lines_corrected (approved by Aditya, 2026-11-11).
सर्वदेवतैः: देवत is not a regular a-stem; the Critical Edition reads सर्वदैवतैः. Corrected to सर्वदैवतैः in lines_corrected (approved by Aditya, 2026-11-11).
अभ्यषिच्य: an augment with ल्यप् is not a possible form; the Critical Edition reads अभ्यषिञ्चत्.
Line 2 has lost its first syllable on Wikisource (त् क्षत्रियो …; 10 syllables for 11). Corrected in lines_corrected (approved by Aditya, 2026-11-11).
Two verses stored as one: the source marker ॥१-२६-१३ lacks its closing ॥.

The first two lines are the page heading and the reciters' credit, not verse text.
Line 2 ends in a stray । before ॥ (… लोकपितामहे । ॥). Kept as printed; proposed (Class B, not applied): the stray । removed.
Line 2 ends in a stray । before ॥ (… वैरग्रहणबुद्धिना । ॥). Kept as printed; proposed (Class B, not applied): the stray । removed.

Line 3: a stray र् in भगवान् र्मुनिर्… (no such word). Explained as printed (भगवान् मुनिः). Proposed (Class B, not applied): भगवान्मुनिर्विस्मयमाययौ. The Critical Edition (1.2.37) reads vālmīkir munir here, so rule A does not apply.

रघुवरकरितं and दशशिरसश्क are not possible words (probably रघुवरचरितं and दशशिरसश्च). Explained as printed with that sense. Class B, not applied: the verse is not in the Critical Edition, so rule A does not apply.
Line 1 lacks its closing । (so also in verses 24–38); च अङ्गरागस्य is left unjoined. Kept as printed (Class B, not applied).
वेदोपबृंह्मणार्थाय: anusvāra and ह्म together. Corrected to वेदोपबृह्मणार्थाय in lines_corrected under rule A (Critical Edition 1.4.5), pending Aditya.
तपः श्लाघ्यैर्महर्षिभिः: a space inside the compound तपःश्लाघ्यैः (Critical Edition 1.4.18 has the compound). Kept as printed (Class B: spacing only, the verse is not impossible as printed).
ब्रुसीम्: probably for बृसीम् (as in verse 22). Kept as printed (Class B: the verse is not in the Critical Edition).
